 Norman Powell goes for 33 points in Friday's win 
 by Nate Miller | Bulls Correspondent | Sat, Nov 14th 2026, 10:23am EST 
 Norman Powell put up 33 points (12-19 FG, 4-8 3PT, 5-6 FT) and grabbed five rebounds in Friday's 125-117 OT win against the Hawks. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 After not playing for more than a week, Powell showed no signs of rust Friday night. The veteran wing reached the 30-point mark for the second time this season, putting a new season-high in 31 minutes. Powell should remain a solid source of points and threes as long as he's healthy.
